keep: Lead with a specific, high-curiosity password/secret question about a document Indians commonly hold (e.g. 'Aadhaar PDF ka password kya hota hai?'). The top reel used this and got 1970 views, 18 shares and 24 saves.
Use the secret_answer format on a concrete, personal-document problem (Aadhaar, PDF edit, file too large). 3 of the top 4 reels used it. Saves and shares are the main reason for the high scores.
Keep the hook short, in plain Hinglish, and about the viewer's own pain ('PDF ko edit kaise karein?', 'What if your PDF is too big?'). These hooks held 8.8–9.2s average watch.
Pick topics that are practical and save-worthy: unlock Aadhaar PDF, compress PDF KB, PDF to Word. Each got 4–24 saves and about 1,200–2,000 views.
Make the hook promise a tool or one-stop answer ('ek hi website kaafi hai'). Even the manual format got 920 views and an 8.7s watch with this hook.
avoid: Hooks that have nothing to do with the topic, such as 'Egypt ke tomb mein shahad' (unlock_pdf) and 'Charging 100% tak mat karo' (resize_image_kb). They got 221 and 435 views and almost no saves.
Narrow, brand-specific or niche password hooks ('HDFC bank statement PDF', 'PAN card PDF', 'e-PAN PDF'). They got 140–290 views and 0–6 saves, and the HDFC one only held 2.2s of watch.
Generic how-to hooks for low-urgency tasks ('Photos ko ek PDF kaise banayein?', 'PDF ka table Excel mein kaise layein?'). They got about 120 views and 3.4–3.5s average watch.
Jargon-first or definition hooks ('Masked Aadhaar kya hota hai?', 'Most people think a PDF page can't become a photo'). They got 4.6–8.8s watch but 0 saves and 0 shares.
Repeating a topic and hook with no change. The same 'Aadhaar PDF ka password' hook got 1970 views the first time and 184 views the second time, a drop of about 90%.
next_tests: Repost the unlock_aadhaar hook with a new angle in the first 2 seconds, such as showing the answer or a number. This checks whether the 1970-view result was the topic or a one-time boost. The 184-view repeat suggests timing or posting differences matter, but with n=2 this is still unproven.

Run 3 reels on compress_pdf_kb or resize_photo_kb that all use a form-rejection hook ('Form ne bola File too large'). Keep the format the same and change only the opening line. This shows whether the pain-point hook works better than the question hook.

Test the same Aadhaar topic across hook styles (question, problem, 'what if'), with the same format and posting time. Right now topic, hook style, format and posting time all vary at once, so none of them can be isolated.

keep: Keep hooks short and specific, because the three top scorers all have simple hooks. The one concrete example is the selfie-to-ID-photo hook ('Can one selfie become an ID photo?'), the only top performer with a real topic. That is 3 of 9 posts, so the pattern is only suggestive.

Make a visible before/after transformation with a clear payoff for one task. The remove_background reel used same_task_before_after. It had the best reach (397) and views (449) of the 9 posts, and it was the top non-manual reel at score 359.

Open with a person-and-situation story hook that gets shared. The signature_bg_remover story ('Meena signed on paper at 10 PM.') got 7 shares from 127 views, which is the best share rate among the topic-specific reels. The word_to_pdf story ('Why did Rohan miss his own interview?') held attention well at 8.2s average watch.

Use hooks that hold viewers past about 8s of average watch. The top 3 reels averaged 8.1s, 9.3s and 6.2s. The weak ones averaged 1.7s to 4.8s. Treat watch time as the signal to protect, because sample sizes are tiny.

Keep a direct call to action pointing to the website, because the top two scores both do this. These two are manual, general posts with a different format (#ilovedocuments, 'Please check our website too'). They got shares (18) and saves (1) despite no topical hook. This is unproven, since they may be benefiting from existing audience or distribution.
avoid: Avoid generic 'one site does everything' pitches such as 'Any PDF or photo job – one free website'. That reel had the lowest watch time (1.7s) and scored 145 with no real topic.
Avoid bold-claim or cost-saving framing like 'Stop paying the cyber cafe for these 5 things'. It averaged only 4.1s watch, and the 5-tool cheat sheet format ran the longest at 32s.

Avoid reels of about 24s to 32s with a task-heavy setup and no emotional pull. Bank statement to Excel (4.8s watch, 0 shares), the signature resize reel (5.8s) and the cheat sheet (4.1s) all lost viewers early.

Avoid plain how-to questions that give no reason to care, such as 'How do you send 4 photos as one PDF?'. It got 0 likes, 0 shares, 0 saves and 0 comments, the only reel with zero engagement of every kind.

Avoid pairing a dry task hook with no visible output. The bank_statement_excel and resize_signature_kb reels both open on a task or number but do not show the result, and they sit at the bottom of the ranking (scores 80 and 91).
next_tests: Re-run the selfie-to-ID-photo concept with a different hook line, keeping the same before/after format. This checks whether the format or the hook produced the 449 views and 397 reach.

Make a story-format reel for the same topic as a weak one, for example jpg_to_pdf or bank_statement_excel, using a Meena-style personal-deadline hook. Compare it against the existing question or how-to version.
Cut one reel to about 15s, using the cheat-sheet or signature-resize content. Compare avg_watch_s and shares against the 29s to 32s versions, to test whether length is behind the weak watch time.
